prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a single animation sprite sheet for a novice exercise guide. Exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, NINE equal SQUARE cells in row-major chronological order, 9 different successive poses of ONE FORWARD HALF REP, no return yet. Same fixed orthographic camera, framing, scale, lighting, floor, person proportions, clothing, face and surface textures across all nine cells. No gutters, gridlines, borders, labels, arrows or text. Each cell shows the whole person, whole apparatus if any, with generous room, no cut-off hands/feet. Reference image is ONLY identity/material/style reference, not pose or machine geometry: muscular adult man, realistically defined muscles, tan natural skin, short dark hair, black shorts and black trainers, matte charcoal grey apparatus, warm off-white studio background and soft fixed floor shadow. Polished realistic colored educational 3D-render illustration; NOT simple low-poly or cartoon. Joint rotations must change continuously across nine poses; all body segment lengths stay identical. Exactly two arms/hands, two legs/feet. Render each cell separately at identical local coordinates. Exercise: SEATED SINGLE-ARM LOW CABLE ROW. This is a CABLE MACHINE, NOT a converging lever machine. Camera three-quarter front from athlete's working right side, so pulling elbow and cable fully visible. Man sits upright on a short fixed black flat bench facing right in frame. Feet braced on a fixed angled metal footplate. Torso upright, chest high, spine neutral, shoulders level. His right hand grips one compact single-hand D-handle attached to ONE visibly thin flexible STEEL CABLE which runs taut diagonally forward-down to ONE LOW PULLEY near the footplate, then into an opaque fixed weight tower farther right. No moving thick steel lever, no giant arm linkage. Left hand rests firmly on left thigh and is stationary. 9 successive right-arm positions: start shoulder neutral/protracted just slightly with elbow almost extended but not locked; bend right elbow gradually through 15,25,35,45,55,65,75,85,95degrees and retract shoulder to bring handle toward right lower ribs/waist. Hand and cable move smoothly from in front of knee toward waist; cable remains straight and taut and physically connected to SAME LOW PULLEY every cell. Upper arm finishes alongside torso, not hugely behind. Right forearm, hand, biceps proportions constant, one visible cable. Torso/pelvis/head/bench/feet/footplate/tower/pulley ALL stationary. Cable length visible increases as handle is pulled, internal resistance hidden in opaque tower. Keep full frame machine compact and identical in all cells. No chest support pad; do not create a second moving handle.
